jobs.title: Implementation Engineer
jobs.description:
At Expel, signing a new customer is just the beginning. The real magic happens when we turn that excitement into a seamless onboarding experience, working integrations, confident security teams, and a customer who's ready to get the most out of our platform.

That's where you come in.

As an Implementation Engineer, you'll own the first 30–60 days of the customer journey, taking customers from their initial sales handoff through technical implementation, enablement, and their first real value with Expel.

This isn't just about configuring tools or checking boxes. You'll be the person bringing everything together, helping customers navigate technical challenges, keeping implementations on track, and making sure they're set up for success long after onboarding is complete.

You'll work closely with customers, our Security Operations Center (SOC), Customer Success, and internal technical teams to deliver an onboarding experience that's thoughtful, efficient, and built around each customer's environment.

**What Expel can do for you:**
------------------------------

* Give you ownership of the customer onboarding experience, from initial handoff through successful implementation and transition to Customer Success.
* Provide opportunities to work with a variety of enterprise security environments, technologies, and customer challenges.
* Connect you with experienced security practitioners across our SOC, engineering, and customer-facing teams.
* Give you a voice in improving how we onboard customers, streamline processes, and deliver value faster.
* Help you continue developing your technical expertise across cybersecurity, cloud environments, and Expel's Workbench platform.
* Offer a remote work environment where you can collaborate across teams while taking ownership of your work.

**What you can do for Expel:**
------------------------------

* **Own the customer onboarding journey.** Manage a portfolio of 15–20+ implementations simultaneously, guiding customers from post-sale handoff through technical setup, enablement, and initial value.
* **Bring customers live with confidence.** Lead technical onboarding, including security integrations, configurations, Workbench training, custom setup, and incident simulations.
* **Help customers get the most out of Expel.** Partner with our SOC to validate customer configurations and ensure they're positioned to detect and respond to real threats.
* **Keep implementations moving.** Establish clear timelines, communicate expectations, manage milestones, and hold customers accountable while maintaining strong relationships.
* **Get ahead of potential issues.** Identify technical blockers, customer readiness gaps, and slipping timelines early, escalating when necessary to prevent onboarding delays and future retention risks.
* **Make customer transitions seamless.** Partner closely with Customer Success to ensure every handoff includes the technical context, customer expectations, and documentation needed for long-term success.
* **Help us continuously improve.** Identify recurring onboarding challenges, provide feedback to Product and internal teams, and recommend improvements that reduce friction and accelerate time-to-value.
* **Support the broader team.** Maintain accurate implementation documentation and provide technical guidance to associate-level teammates when needed.

**What You Should Bring With You**
----------------------------------

* 2+ years of experience implementing SaaS solutions, security services, or IT services within enterprise environments.
* Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Implementation Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Technical Support, or Professional Services.
* Working knowledge of cybersecurity technologies, including EDR, SIEM, NDR, and CASB, and how these tools support enterprise security operations.
* A solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, DNS, firewalls, and proxies, particularly as they relate to security integrations and deployments.
* Familiarity with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and their native security services.
* Understanding of enterprise security best practices and common compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, and HIPAA.
* The technical troubleshooting skills to trace data flows, identify integration issues, and work through challenges between a customer's environment and Expel's platform.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical concepts for security practitioners, business stakeholders, and customers.
* Experience managing multiple customer implementations or technical projects simultaneously, keeping priorities organized and timelines on track.
* The confidence to set expectations, navigate difficult conversations, and hold customers accountable while maintaining positive relationships.
* Good judgment around when to troubleshoot independently, when to escalate, and how to adapt when a customer's environment doesn't fit the standard playbook.
* A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

**Additional Notes**
--------------------

The base salary range for this role is between $93,900 USD and $136,200 USD, with a target range of $104,000 to $126,500, plus bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

Jeppesen ForeFlight is redefining the future of aviation technology, equipping pilots, operators, and decision-makers with the software tools to forge bold new digital paths that push past the expected. We stand with those who dream bigger, fly farther, and seek to explore the next frontier in the cockpit and operations center.  
  
Jeppesen ForeFlight is seeking an Implementation Specialist reporting to the Senior Manager, Professional Services Implementation & Deployment, supporting our Flight Planning implementation and migration programs.  
  
As an Implementation Specialist, you will own the end-to-end migration and onboarding of Commercial, Military, and Business/General Aviation customers moving from legacy flight-planning platforms onto our next-generation flight-planning system, as well as new customers implementing directly on the platform across all service tiers. You'll configure customer environments, coordinate testing and validation, and train customers to use our products confidently, guiding them from post-signature through go-live and into active operations, all while managing multiple concurrent implementation and migration projects.  
  
A successful candidate is customer-focused and comfortable being the technical point of contact for an airline customer moving through a multi-stage migration or implementation, from onboarding through production go-live and handoff to support. You're equally comfortable configuring applications, walking a customer through it live, and keeping your own project status current. You either know the flight dispatch/flight-planning space already, or you're eager to learn it quickly.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
As part of the Implementation team, you will:

* Own customer migrations from legacy flight-planning platforms to the next-generation Jeppesen ForeFlight flight-planning system, and manage new customer implementations across all service tiers, from initial assessment through production go-live and handoff to ongoing support.
* Migrate applicable customer configuration data and operational parameters from legacy or third-party systems into the new platform, and define minimum output/reporting requirements together with the customer.
* Configure customer-specific environments, including direct-connect integrations with third-party IT systems such as scheduling systems, departure control systems, maintenance systems, EFB systems, and post-flight analysis systems.
* Coordinate cross-platform migration cases that overlap with an active implementation, partnering with other internal support teams on shared accounts.
* Support migrations between related tracking and fleet-management products for customers transitioning between them.
* Triage reported issue to determine whether it's a software defect requiring a Development fix and release, a configuration change, or a third-party integration issue.
* Serve as the sole owner and primary point of accountability for each implementation project from kickoff through go-live, independently managing timelines, milestones, risks, and deliverables without requiring day-to-day oversight.
* Coordinate test-and-evaluation to production transitions, including validation testing with customers.
* Use AI-powered tools to speed up configuration, documentation, and troubleshooting work, and help the broader team adopt them.
* Travel to customer sites on occasion, as needed.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in flight-planning/dispatch software implementation, customer onboarding, or a related customer-facing technical role.
* Strong technical aptitude, comfortable learning and configuring flight-planning/dispatch software without a traditional software engineering background.
* Hands-on experience configuring software applications.
* Experience diagnosing flight-plan output issues and troubleshooting data authored by upstream flight-planning vendors.
* Willingness to learn and apply AI-powered tools to accelerate implementation work, such as triaging log files and diagnostic evidence and drafting first-pass responses across multiple concurrent customer threads; prior hands-on experience with AI tools is a plus.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to and training customers.
* Strong critical thinking and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and prioritize independently.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in airline operations, flight dispatch, or aviation technology.
* Current or former pilot experience, or a dispatcher certificate/license from a regional governmental aviation authority, is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with software migrations.
* Experience with system integrations and network concepts.
* Ability to digitally track work for project efforts.
* Proven ability to coordinate internally to convey customer requirements.
* Comfort working across time zones with international customers.

**Why Join Us**

At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees, and we empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services. We strive to provide our employees with a world-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. Our benefits package includes but is not limited to the following:

* Medical, dental, vision insurance with Employer paid health premiums
* Open PTO Policy
* 401(k) with up to 10% company matching and immediate vesting
* 12 Weeks Paid Paternal Leave
* Flight Training Rewards

Pay is based upon candidate experience and qualifications, as well market and business considerations: Summary Pay Range: $122,000-$150,000

**Agency Onboarding Specialist**

**CarePortal**

CarePortal is Care-Sharing technology that drives action for local kids and families in crisis. We believe that through the Church and Community, there can be More Than Enough care for every child, through the power of Care-Sharing and the love of Jesus. We do this through the local Church and in collaboration with child-serving organizations, businesses, and people who care—that’s where you come in.

CarePortal, LLC, a subsidiary of the nonprofit organization The Global Orphan Project (GO Project), is Care-Sharing technology that drives action for local kids and families in crisis.

This platform, which brings Christian churches to the point of care for each request made on behalf of children and families, can be used to connect a diverse network of churches, child-serving agencies, businesses, and individuals who care. Learn more at www.careportal.org.

*CarePortal, LLC offers a competitive benefits package for full-time positions (30+ hours per week) including health, dental, vision and employer paid life insurance, retirement savings and generous PTO plan and a highly competitive, market-indexed compensation when compared to similar non-profit roles. jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Bankjoy is a Y Combinator and Bessemer Venture Partner backed FinTech startup. We are changing the way community banks and credit unions do business, enabling them to become tech-driven and digital first. Bankjoy provides modern digital banking products including mobile banking, online banking, online account opening, loan origination, and conversational AI. Our mission is to revolutionize banking tech infrastructure by leading digital transformation at financial institutions — big and small.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring a Senior Implementation Manager to join our Implementation team, reporting to the Director of Implementation. You'll lead complex digital banking implementations, core migrations, and product expansions from discovery through go-live and stabilization. You'll own the delivery plan, align client and vendor responsibilities, resolve blockers, and keep stakeholders informed when scope, timing, or readiness changes.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll configure and validate client environments, lead testing and launch preparation, and mentor Implementation Managers and Specialists.  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Own complex client implementations from sales handoff and discovery through configuration, testing, launch, stabilization, and transition to Support and Client Success.
* Translate contracted scope into requirements, gap analysis, milestones, dependencies, owners, and acceptance criteria. Resolve gaps early and manage changes to scope and delivery commitments.
* Lead kickoff meetings, working sessions, and client status calls. Explain product limitations and core-specific requirements clearly, including to nontechnical client teams.
* Coordinate core providers, third-party vendors, Product, Engineering, QA, Operations, and implementation colleagues. Maintain accountability for each dependency and decision.
* Configure and validate environments through Bankjoy's admin tools. Document client settings, integration prerequisites, data requirements, and known limitations.
* Maintain Smartsheet plans and the Implementation Status sheet with current dates, owners, risks, decisions, and a written weekly status update. Escalate blockers with a proposed recovery plan.
* Lead user acceptance testing (UAT), client training, and defect triage. Reproduce issues, distinguish configuration or data problems from defects, and give technical owners actionable evidence.
* Coordinate cutover plans, readiness reviews, go/no-go recommendations, and rollback planning with technical owners. Confirm client sign-off and required approvals before launch.
* Handle senior client escalations with clear facts, realistic options, and agreed next steps. Manage concurrent priorities while protecting delivery quality and client trust.
* Lead post-launch stabilization and handoff, including configuration records, open issues, owners, and support expectations. Improve core-specific guides and templates, and mentor colleagues through complex delivery work.

**What You Bring**

* Banking or fintech experience is required. You understand accounts, transfers, limits, digital banking workflows, and the operating needs of credit unions or banks.
* 5+ years in software implementation, client onboarding, or technical project management, with demonstrated ownership of complex financial institution projects from planning through launch.
* Experience with a core banking system or digital banking platform, including hands-on configuration, integration dependencies, and technical troubleshooting.
* A record of managing concurrent client projects, external vendors, scope changes, and delivery risks with clear ownership and current project records.
* Practical experience with UAT, defect investigation, cutover planning, launch-readiness decisions, and post-launch stabilization.
* Clear written and verbal communication, including difficult client conversations, executive updates, and explaining technical constraints without making unsupported commitments.
* Experience mentoring colleagues and improving implementation processes. Comfort working in a lean team and doing configuration, documentation, and follow-up yourself.
* Experience with Smartsheet, Jira, and Confluence or equivalents. Comfortable using company-approved AI tools for documentation and analysis while verifying outputs and following data-handling requirements.

**What You Get**
----------------

* A fast-paced and collaborative environment
* Competitive compensation
* Stock options at a well-funded startup
* We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for individuals on our base plan, with significant contributions toward all other plan options (USA).
* We cover 100% of extended medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family under our single, comprehensive plan (Canada).
* Retirement plan with 4% company matching
* 8 weeks paid parental leave for birthing parents, 4 weeks for non-birthing
* 3-5 weeks PTO depending on tenure
* 5 health days
* 15 holidays
* End of year shutdown
* Performance-based bonuses
* Remote first culture

**Equal Employment Opportunities at Bankjoy**
---------------------------------------------

Bankjoy is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds for all of its tech, non-tech, and leadership roles. Bankjoy provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability.
